# curl — 2016 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 26 curl CVEs of 2016 are in `data/cve/vendors/curl/2016.jsonl`.

### CVE-2016-9952
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2018-03-12 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: 8.1
- CWE: n/a; CWE-295 CWE-295 Improper Certificate Validation
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 8.1 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

The verify_certificate function in lib/vtls/schannel.c in libcurl 7.30.0 through 7.51.0, when built for Windows CE using the schannel TLS backend, makes it easier for remote attackers to conduct man-in-the-middle attacks via a crafted wildcard SAN in a server certificate, as demonstrated by "*.com."

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a
- haxx / curl: affected 7.27.0 <=7.51.0 (custom)
